messages:
Nina (Docs): Putting up a tiny PR to update the model card for 'lyra-embed-8b' — adding a short client-side sharding example and clarifying sequence limits. Quick review appreciated.

Raj (ML): Please include an explicit practical limit: 8192 tokens for quantized builds. Note: quantized variants will best-effort truncate beyond that and you can see quality regressions.

Cam (SDK): I'll replace the legacy .embed() snippet with embeddings.create and add a small Promise.all example for sharded requests. Draft: ```js
const shards = shardInputs(inputs, 4);
await Promise.all(shards.map(s => client.embeddings.create({ model: 'lyra-embed-8b', input: s })));
```

Iris (Eng): Do not recommend internal headers like X-Embed-Shard publicly. Show deterministic hashing (stable-hash -> bucket) as the pattern. Also file an infra redirect if older slugs exist.

Nina (Docs): Good calls. I'll add: "sequence_limit: 8192 (quantized: best-effort truncation; embedding quality may degrade near the cutoff)." and a compact hash-bucket pseudocode snippet.

InfraBot: Redirect request infra-redirects#92 created to map legacy /models/lyra -> /catalog/models/lyra-embed-8b.

Cam (SDK): Added a small tip: "Batch shards to improve throughput; keep per-shard payloads < ~400KB to avoid client timeouts." Also included a Python asyncio example.

Raj (ML): Also add a bench note: "q8 shows better stability for sequences >4096; use q8 for production long-context embedding workloads."

Iris (Eng): Redirect deployed (301).

Nina (Docs): Merged PR after CI passed. Pinged support + release notes. Closing thread. :tada:
